data.title: A Victorian gem on Cerro Alegre
data.text: Stunning heritage hotel with attentive staff. Olivia at the front desk gave us the best restaurant tips for Valparaíso. Breakfast with local produce was a highlight.

data.title: Lovely heritage building, patchy wifi upstairs
data.text: Beautiful boutique hotel with character. WiFi was a bit patchy on the upper floors but the staff fixed it within a few hours. Breakfast was excellent.

data.title: Sunset terrace is worth the trip
data.text: Cozy boutique with character. The view from the rooftop terrace at sunset is worth the trip alone. Cleanliness top-notch and concierge service excellent.

data.title: Beautiful but smaller than photos
data.text: Beautiful location but the room was smaller than the photos suggested and the heater was loud. Front desk was apologetic and offered a free breakfast.

data.title: Best seafood we had in Chile
data.text: Exceptional service from the moment we arrived. The restaurant has the best seafood we tried in Chile. We will return on our next trip to Valparaíso.

data.title: Great workspace for a short business trip
data.text: Stayed two nights for work. Desk was comfortable, room was quiet, breakfast was hot and quick. WiFi held up for video calls. Highly recommended for solo business travelers.

data.title: Birthday celebration done right
data.text: They surprised my friend with a cake and a hand-drawn postcard of the hill, signed by the team. Such a thoughtful touch. Spacious room with high ceilings.

data.title: Charming but maintenance is patchy
data.text: The shower was lukewarm on the first morning. Maintenance team responded the same day but the confirmation took a while. They offered breakfast credit as compensation.

data.title: Perfect for exploring Valparaíso
data.text: Close to the funiculars and to all the famous murals. Generous breakfast with homemade preserves. Bilingual staff handled our kid's allergy without missing a beat.

data.title: Quiet retreat with a view
data.text: Weekend escape from Santiago. They asked about preferences ahead of arrival and respected a gluten-free request at breakfast. Personalized service throughout.
